title: The same for an English-speaking owner: the hub shows the session's card instead of asking the question again
note: 12.10, PR #108: the hub asked a session's question again with its own form — the owner had two cards about one thing and closed the extra one himself. Fix: hub question show qN — the same card in the hub's chat, the answer goes to the session; the core's addendum to the owner's words and hub-home/CLAUDE.md say so. The history is invented (events): the hub has no conversation, the owner gave maps a task, it asked him with a form and ended its turn.
